meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目从起步到现在的开发历程整理成一篇叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想回顾项目从零到现在的完整开发历程并写成一份报告
copy.tagline_en: Turn a project's development history into a narrative report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to retell a project's full development journey as a report

howto.what: 读取 claude-mem 中记录的项目时间线，生成一篇「Journey Into [项目]」叙事报告，涵盖架构演变、关键突破、调试过程等，并保存为 markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求写时间线报告、项目历史分析、开发历程或完整项目报告时触发；前提是 claude-mem worker 在运行且该项目已有观察记录。

say.text: 给 tokyo 项目写一份时间线报告
say.note: 先抓取完整时间线并预估 token，等你确认

say.text: 分析我这个项目的完整开发历史
say.note: 未指明项目时用当前目录名

say.text: 总结整个开发历史，保存到 ./history.md
say.note: 报告输出到你指定的路径

howto.what_en: Reads a project's full timeline from claude-mem and produces a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report covering architecture, breakthroughs, debugging and token economics, saved as a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report; requires the claude-mem worker running with recorded observations.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for the tokyo project
say_en.note: Fetches the full timeline and estimates tokens first

say_en.text: Analyze my project's full development history
say_en.note: Uses the current directory name if unspecified

say_en.text: Summarize the whole dev history, save to ./history.md
say_en.note: Report is saved to your chosen path
